---
title: No Navbar
navbar: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'nav#quarto-sidebar[aria-label="Site"]'
        -
          - 'nav.navbar'
          - 'nav[aria-label="Section"]'
---

With the navbar disabled, the sidebar carries the site-level navigation and its label adapts.
